title: Coproduct preservation for proper étale derived direct image
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category and let g : Z → Y be a proper morphism of schemes. Then the total right derived direct image Rg_* on the unbounded derived categories of A-valued sheaves on the small étale sites preserves coproducts of every set-indexed family.

source.place: Proof, first paragraph: proper derived direct image preserves arbitrary coproducts before Brown representability

proof.text: On every quasi-compact étale open of Y, properness gives a finite cohomological-amplitude bound for g and the higher direct images commute with filtered colimits of sheaves. Thus the finite-amplitude K-injective computation of the total right derived functor identifies its coproduct comparison with an isomorphism on each such open. Restriction to these opens is exact and jointly detects isomorphisms, so the local comparisons assemble to the global coproduct comparison.
